verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out and no explicit statement that user data is excluded from model training. The general claim that Zero "does not track, collect, or sell your data" and the self-hosting option are related privacy-posture features, not a documented capability addressing AI training. Zero also routes data through LLMs and Perplexity, and the evidence does not say how those third parties may use it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
